label: Treats a container as a virtual machine
description: The learner thinks each container boots its own kernel.

remediation.explanation: A container shares the host kernel. A VM runs a guest kernel.

label: Confuses an image with a container
description: The learner treats image commands and container commands as interchangeable.

remediation.explanation: An image is a template. A container is a running instance.

label: Thinks image layers disappear with the container
description: The learner confuses the container's writable layer with the image layers.

remediation.explanation: Image layers are read-only and remain until the image is removed.

label: Reverses host and container ports
description: The learner writes container:host instead of host:container.

remediation.explanation: The host port comes first. The container port comes second.

label: Confuses a named volume with a bind mount
description: The learner treats Docker-managed storage and a host directory as the same.

remediation.explanation: A named volume is managed by Docker. A bind mount maps a host path.

label: Thinks containers need host networking to talk
description: The learner reaches for host networking instead of a user-defined network.

remediation.explanation: User-defined bridge networks provide name resolution without host networking.

label: Misorders Dockerfile instructions
description: The learner places filesystem instructions before FROM.

remediation.explanation: FROM establishes the base image before COPY or RUN.

label: Confuses build and run
description: The learner uses docker run where docker build is needed.

remediation.explanation: docker build creates an image. docker run starts a container.

label: Treats Compose as a production platform
description: The learner assumes a compose file covers deployment, secrets, and scaling.

remediation.explanation: Compose describes services. Production needs a host, deployment process, and secrets plan.

label: Confuses compose build and up
description: The learner expects docker compose build to start services.

remediation.explanation: build creates images. up starts services.

label: Skips logs during troubleshooting
description: The learner changes or deletes containers before reading the evidence.

remediation.explanation: Logs and exit codes are the first evidence. Read them before changing anything.
